description: This file defines a class 'Surrogates' within the PdfSharp library, specifically for rendering text snippets involving surrogate pairs, emojis, and different fonts in PDF graphics context. It includes methods for rendering unicode characters, emojis, and specific fonts onto a PDF graphics object.

classes.name: Surrogates
classes.description: A class for demonstrating surrogate pairs and font rendering in PDFs.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overrides the base method to draw surrogate characters, emojis, and text using various fonts in a PDF graphics context.
